subject: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@novagrid.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. To keep the vendor onboarding moving, procurement needs a provisional PO number issued so finance can start the ledger entries while legal finishes the final SOW redlines. Can you confirm the correct billing contact and whether the first two invoice line items are: (1) "Platform subscription - onboarding month" and (2) "Professional services - onboarding (flat)"? We need dollar amounts for each to set the initial spend cap.

I attached our PO template (NovaGrid_PO_Template.xlsx) — please return with the line-item mapping filled and the W9 if you haven't sent it already. Once we receive that we will:
- Provisionally lock a PO number and a temporary spend cap for the first 60 days
- Add a ledger entry so accounting can route the first payment to the correct cost center
- Set an internal notification to review cap for next 30 days based on actual usage

Cc'ing Marissa for procurement approval and Karthik for the spend-cap signoff. Grace, please confirm whether we can set the provisional cap at $75k while SOW finalizes or if you recommend a different threshold.

Next step ask: please send back the completed PO template and W9 by EOD Wednesday 5/5 so we can lock the provisional PO number in this week's batch.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: NovaGrid_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

-----Original Message-----
From: Aisha Malik <aisha@novagrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novagrid.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:02:13 -0400
Subject: Re: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding

Hi Ben —

Thanks, and great meeting. Quick clarifications from our side before we return the template:
1) Line items: NovaGrid wants to split professional services into two SLAs (Implementation and Custom Integration). Can Redwood map these into separate line items on the PO? Our accounting requires separate line-item granularity for multi-vendor billing.
2) Amounts: We typically invoice monthly for subscription and milestone-based for services. For provisioning the provisional cap, would you accept $60k as a starting cap for the first 60 days while the SOW milestones are finalized?
3) Tax docs: attaching our W9 now.

We attached: NovaGrid_W9.pdf. We'll return the filled PO template by tomorrow afternoon. If you need the signed onboarding form earlier, Sam Lewis (cc'd on internal route) can expedite.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Head of Finance Operations
NovaGrid

--
Attachment: NovaGrid_W9.pdf (pdf)

-----Original Message-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, aisha@novagrid.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:45:22 -0700
Subject: Re: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding

Ben / Aisha —

Thanks for the details. Procurement is fine with splitting professional services into two separate line items: "Professional services - Implementation" and "Professional services - Custom integration". Please ensure the PO template reflects separate line quantities/amounts for those two lines.

Karthik / Grace — internal note: target provisional PO number block for this onboarding is PO-2027-3201 (provisional). Recommend provisional spend-cap: $60,000 for 60 days per NovaGrid request. If usage hits 75% of cap earlier, ops will trigger a cap review and escalation to finance.

Action items I will own:
- Lock the provisional PO number in the procurement ledger today and notify accounting date-stamped entry.
- Add memo field on the PO: "SOW pending - provisional cap; finalize by 2027-06-15"
- Route filled PO template + W9 to AP with the provisional PO number and cap attached.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding

All —

Agree with Marissa on the provisional cap at $60k. Finance prefers the provisional cap to be listed with an internal spend code (SC-RED-07) so we can track against the correct cost center for initial billing. I can add the spend code after Marissa locks PO-2027-3201 in the ledger.

Karthik Iyer
Revenue Ops / Finance Partnering
Redwood Inference

--

From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@financepartner.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 14:05:41 -0400
Subject: NovaGrid onboarding form (signed)

Ben / Marissa —

Attached is the signed onboarding form (NovaGrid_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf). NovaGrid confirms the split line items and accepts the provisional cap of $60,000 for 60 days. They will route milestone invoices to procurement@novagrid.com and billing@novagrid.com.

Please confirm the provisional PO number and the spend code so we can schedule the first invoice for the next billing cycle.

Thanks,
Sam Lewis
Accounts Payable Liaison
FinancePartner (vendor services)

--

Attachment: NovaGrid_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf (pdf)

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha@novagrid.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO issuance ledger and provisional spend-lock for NovaGrid onboarding

Hi Aisha / Sam —

Confirming receipt of the signed onboarding form and W9. Procurement has locked provisional PO number PO-2027-3201 with spend code SC-RED-07 and provisional spend cap $60,000 for 60 days (memo: SOW pending - finalize by 2027-06-15). Accounting will see the ledger entry today and route first payment to the agreed billing contacts.

Next steps for NovaGrid:
- Submit first invoice referencing PO-2027-3201 and line-item codes as listed in the filled PO template.
- If any invoice uses combined professional services rather than split SLAs, AP will ask for an internal remap; please keep invoice granularity to avoid delays.
- We will run a spend-review on 2027-06-01 and either extend or adjust the cap based on milestone progress.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
